mapper.select: SELECT m.*, p.permission_code FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_id = m.permission_id ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE rm.menu_id IN #{id} ORDER BY ur.user_id
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} FOR UPDATE
